# CrediScore Neural Underwriter Specification

## Intended Purpose
Automated credit scoring and loan default prediction for retail mortgage applications.

## Risk Management (Article 9)
A continuous risk management system is active and integrated with internal banking compliance frameworks.

## Data Governance (Article 10)
Training data provenance is documented across 500,000 anonymized historical loan files.

## Bias Examination (Article 10(2)(f))
A preliminary fairness audit was performed on credit scores, though comprehensive disparate impact testing across immigrant zip codes is planned for Q4.

## Human Oversight (Article 14)
A manual override capability is currently in development and planned for future release in version 1.1. Underwriting decisions in beta pilot operate without human oversight fallback.

## Record-Keeping (Article 12)
Inference logs and transaction traces are recorded to cloud storage.

## Cybersecurity (Article 15)
Adversarial testing against feature manipulation is under evaluation.
